name: Teen Advisory and Advocacy Board
what_you_do: Give the library feedback on teen programs, speak up for teens, and write monthly reflections. Finishers earn up to 100 service hours.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 14 to 18 who live in Hillsborough County.
pay_detail: Unpaid; earns up to 100 Bright Futures and school service hours
duration: Five months (July 8 to Nov 7 in 2026), hybrid
deadline_text: The 2026 board (July 8 to November 7) is filled. The page says to check back for a future chance to apply.
how_to_apply: Not open now. Watch the page for the next chance to apply. The page lists phone 813-273-3652 and text 813-352-1603.
notes: Finishers earn up to 100 service hours, per the library. Students must complete all assignments and sessions to be awarded 100 hours.
